description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for pre-write test-case enumeration (what to test, edge cases, coverage breadth). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours: assertion quality (testing-anti-patterns), after-the-fact coverage review (judge-test-coverage), failing-test diagnosis (systematic-debugging), stack-specific execution.

welche Testfälle brauchen wir für dieses Feature — auch Grenzfälle und Fehlerpfade?
build a case matrix for this behavior — happy, boundary, error, abuse
ask a subagent what else we could test so coverage is broad
this assertion looks tautological — is the test overfit?
are the tests on this finished diff enough?
